gateway_exclusions.reason: No eligible attachment at tested times; explicit experiment exclusions.

input_provenance.registration: fixed nearest non-excluded gateway; ties by gateway ID
input_provenance.destination_model: one unique prefix per gateway; no PoP mapping

coverage.limitation: Coverage is dated by the source publication; no inference of current service or address capacity.

sampling.method: with-replacement population-count weighted cell centers; PCG64
sampling.boundary_cells: cell-center inclusion; no partial-cell population allocation

sampling.population: GHS-POP R2023A E2020 WGS84 30 arcseconds V1.0; persons per cell
sampling.population_attribution: European Commission, Joint Research Centre, GHSL

input_provenance.positions: SGP4 2.25 WGS72; TEME to pseudo-Earth-fixed via GMST; UT1=UTC, polar motion ignored
input_provenance.ground: WGS84 ellipsoid, altitude zero; users: nearest satellite at minimum elevation 25 degrees; gateways: up to 8 nearest satellites at minimum elevation 25 degrees
input_provenance.user_attachments: held fixed at before time; unattached users retained as baseline-unreachable
input_provenance.update_scope: all gateway attachment changes between the two times

method: fresh synchronous DV per frozen snapshot; not a withdrawal/convergence-time simulation
